summary:
Implementation plan for:
1. Zero-Click Real Mobile App Launching: Directly launches the native Android phone app via Android Intent URIs on voice command without opening the in-app screen overlay, while keeping Avani running in the background.
2. Ultra Shield Relocation: Relocates the Ultra Shield / Noise Isolation control from the top bar into the three-dots dropdown menu to maintain a clean header.
3. Call Privacy & Complete Audio Cut: Completely disconnects microphone audio streaming and speech synthesis during phone calls to guarantee zero surveillance / privacy during personal calls, automatically resuming hands-free when the call ends.
4. Comprehensive Voice Phone Control Suite: Full Hindi/English voice control for native device apps and utilities.
